1.1: Sheloshim vashesh keretot battora. habba al haem, veal eshet haav, veal hakkalla, habba al hazzechur, veal habbehema, vehaishsha hamevia et habbehema aleha, habba al ishsha uvittah, veal eshet ish, habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda, hamegaddef, vehaoved avoda zara, vehannoten mizzaro lammolech, uvaal ov, hamechallel et hashshabbat, vetame sheachal et hakkodesh, vehabba lammikdash tame, haochel chelev, vedam, notar, ufiggul, hashshochet vehammaale bachutz, haochel chametz befesach, vehaochel vehaose melacha veyom hakkippurim, hamefattem et hashshemen, vehamefattem et hakketoret, vehassach beshemen hammishcha. happesach vehammila bemitzvot ase:
1.2: Al ellu chayyavim al zedonam karet, veal shiggatam chattat, veal lo hoda shellahen asham taluy, chutz min hametamme mikdash vekadashav, mifne shehu veole veyored, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, af hamegaddef, shenneemar (Bamidbar 15), tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga, yatza megaddef, sheeno ose maase:
1.3: Yesh meviot karban veneechol, veyesh meviot veeno neechol, veyesh sheenan meviot. ellu meviot karban veneechol. hammappelet kemin behema chayya vaof, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyehe vo mitztzurat haadam. hammappelet sandal, o shilya, veshafir merukkam, vehayyotze mechuttach. vechen shifcha shehippila, mevia karban veneechol:
1.4: Ellu meviot veeno neechol. hammappelet veen yadua ma hippila, vechen shete nashim shehippilu, achat mimmin petur veachat mimmin chova. amar rabbi yose, ematay, bizman shehalchu zo lemizrach vezo lemaarav. aval im hayu shetehen omdot keachat, meviot karban veneechol:
1.5: Ellu sheenan meviot. hammappelet shafir male mayim, male dam, male geninim, hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim shekatzim uremasim, hammappelet yom arbaim, veyotze dofen. rabbi shimon mechayyev beyotze dofen:
1.6: Hammappelet or lishmonim veechad, bet shammay potrin min hakkarban, bet hillel mechayyevim. amru vet hillel levet shammay, may shena or lishmonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad. im shave lo lattuma, lo yishve lo lakkarban. amru lahem bet shammay, lo, im amartem bemappelet yom shemonim veechad, shekken yatza veshaa shehi reuya lehavi vah karban, tomru vemappelet or lishmonim veechad, shello yatza veshaa shehi reuya lehavi vah karban. amru lahen bet hillel, vahare hammappelet yom shemonim veechad shechal lihyot beshabbat tochiach, shello yatza veshaa shehi reuya lehavi vah karban vechayyevet bakkarban. amru lahem bet shammay, lo, im amartem bemappelet yom shemonim veechad shechal lihyot beshabbat, sheaf al pi sheeno rauy lekarban yachid, rauy lekarban tzibbur, tomru vemappelet or lishmonim veechad, sheen hallayla rauy lo lekarban yachid velo lekarban tzibbur. haddamim enan mochichin, shehammappelet betoch melot, dameha temein, ufetura min hakkarban:
1.7: Haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamishsha zivot usefek chamishsha ledot, mevia karban echad, veochelet bazzevachim, veen hashshear aleha chova. chamesh ledot vaddaot, chamesh zivot vaddaot, mevia karban echad, veochelet bazzevachim, vehashshear aleha chova. maase sheamdu kinnim birushalayim bedinre zahav. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, hammaon hazze, lo alin hallayla, ad sheyyehu vedinarin. nichnas levet din velimmed, haishsha sheyyesh aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot, chamesh zivot vaddaot, mevia karban echad, veochelet bazzevachim, veen hashshear aleha chova. veamdu kinnim bo vayyom berivatayim:

2.1: Arbaa mechussere chippurim vearbaa meviin al hazzadon kishgaga. ellu hen mechussere chippurim. hazzav, vehazzava, vehayyoledet, vehametzora. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, ger, mechussar kappara ad sheyyizzarek alav haddam. venazir, leyeno vetiglachto vetumato:
2.2: Ellu meviin al hazzadon kishgaga. habba al hashshifcha, venazir shennitma, veal shevuat haedut, veal shevuat happikkadon:
2.3: Chamishsha meviin karban echad al averot harebe, vachamishsha meviim karban ole veyored. ellu meviin karban echad al averot harebe. habba al hashshifcha biot harebe, venazir shennitma tumot harebe, vehamekanne leishto al yede anashim harebe, umetzora shennitnagga negaim harebe. hevi tzipporav venitnagga, lo alu lo, ad sheyyavi et chattato. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyavi et ashamo:
2.4: Haishsha sheyyalda veladot harebe, hippila vetoch shemonim nekeva vechazra vehippila vetoch shemonim nekeva, vehammappelet teomim, rabbi yehuda omer, mevia al harishon veenah mevia al hashsheni. mevia al hashshelishi veenah mevia al harvii. ellu meviin karban ole veyored. al shemiat hakkol, veal bittuy sefatayim, veal tumat mikdash vekadashav, vehayyoledet, vehametzora. uma ben hashshifcha leven kol haarayot. shello shavta lahen lo vaonesh velo vakkarban, shekkol haarayot bechattat vehashshifcha beasham. kol haarayot binkeva, veshifcha bezachar. kol haarayot, echad haish veechad haishsha shavin bammakkot uvakkarban, uvashshifcha lo hishva et haish laishsha bammakkot velo et haishsha laish bakkarban. kol haarayot, asa vahen et hameare chaggomer, vechayyav al kol bia uvia. ze chomer hechmir bashshifcha, sheasa vah et hammezid kashshogeg:
2.5: Ezo hi shifcha. kol shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin, shenneemar (Vayikra 19), vehafde lo nifdata, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer, zo hi shifcha vaddait. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, kol haarayot meforashot, uma shiyyur, en lanu ella shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin:
2.6: Kol haarayot, echad gadol veechad katan, hakkatan patur. echad er veechad yashen, hayyashen patur. echad shogeg veechad mezid, hashshogeg bechattat vehammezid behikkaret:

3.1: Amru lo achalta chelev, mevi chattat. ed omer achal veed omer lo achal, ishsha omeret achal veishsha omeret lo achal, mevi asham taluy. ed omer achal vehu omer lo achalti, patur. shenayim omrim achal vehu omer lo achalti, rabbi meir mechayyev. amar rabbi meir, im heviuhu shenayim lemita chamura, lo yeviuhu lekarban hakkal. amru lo, ma im yirtze lomar mezid hayiti:
3.2: Achal chelev vechelev behelem echad, eno chayyav ella chattat echat. achal chelev vedam venotar ufiggul behelem echad, chayyav al kol echad veechad. ze chomer beminin harebe mimmin echad. vechomer bemin echad mimminin harebe, sheim achal kachatzi zayit vechazar veachal kachatzi zayit mimmin echad, chayyav. mishshene minin, patur:
3.3: Vechamma yishhe haochlan. keillu achalan kelayot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyishhe mittechilla vead sof kede achilat peras. achal ochalin temein, veshata mashkin temein, shata reviit yayin venichnas lammikdash, veshaha kede achilat peras. rabbi eliezer omer, im hifsik bah o shennatan letocho mayim kol shehu, patur:
3.4: Yesh ochel achila achat vechayyav aleha arba chattaot veasham echad. tame sheachal et hachelev, vehaya notar, min mukdashim, uveyom hakkippurim. rabbi meir omer, im hayta shabbat vehotzio vefiv, chayyav. amru lo, eno min hashshem:
3.5: Yesh ba via achat vechayyav aleha shesh chattaot. habba al bitto, chayyav aleha mishshum bitto vaachoto veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv veeshet ish venidda. vehabba al bat bitto, chayyav aleha mishshum bat bitto vechallato vaachot ishto veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv veeshet ish venidda. rabbi yose omer, im avar hazzaken unesaah, chayyav aleha mishshum eshet av. vechen habba al bat ishto, veal bat bat ishto:
3.6: Habba al chamoto, chayyav aleha mishshum chamoto vechallato vaachot ishto veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv veeshet ish venidda. vechen habba al em chamoto, veal em chamiv. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, habba al chamoto, chayyav aleha mishshum chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv. amru lo, shelashtan shem echad hen:
3.7: Amar rabbi akiva, shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua baitlis shel emmaom, shehalchu likkach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel, habba al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo behelem echad mahu, chayyav achat al kullan, o achat al kol achat veechat, veamru li, lo shamanu. aval shamanu, habba al chamesh nashav niddot behelem echad, shehu chayyav al kol achat veachat. veroin anu shehaddevarim kal vachomer:
3.8: Veod shealan rabbi akiva. evar hameduldal bivhema, mahu. amru lo, lo shamanu. aval shamanu beevar hameduldal beadam, shehu tahor. shekkach hayu mukke shechin shebbirushalayim osin, holech lo erev pesach etzel harofe vechotcho ad shehu manniach bo chisora, vetochavo vesira, vehu nimshach mimmennu, vehalla ose fischo, veharofe ose fischo. veroin anu shehaddevarim kal vachomer:
3.9: Veod shealan rabbi akiva. hashshochet chamishsha zevachim bachutz behelem echad, mahu. chayyav achat al kullam, o achat al kol achat veechat. amru lo, lo shamanu. amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati veochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyin behelem echad, shehu chayyav al kol echad veechad mishshum meila, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer. amar rabbi shimon, lo chach shealan rabbi akiva. ella, beochel notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem echad, mahu. chayyav achat al kullan, o achat al kol achat veechat. amru lo, lo shamanu. amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati veochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyim behelem echad, shehu chayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum meila, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer. amar rabbi akiva, im halacha, nekabbel. veim ladin, yesh teshuva. amar lo, hashev. amar lo, lo, im amarta vimila sheasa vah et hammaachil kaochel veet hamehanne kannehene, tzeraf hammeila lizman merubbe, tomar benotar, sheen bo achad mikkol ellu:
3.10: Amar rabbi akiva, shaalti et rabbi eliezer, haose melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe meen melacha achat, behelem echad, ma hu. chayyav achat al kullan, o achat al kol achat veechat. amar li, chayyav al kol achat veachat, mikkal vachomer, uma im hannidda, sheen bah totzaot harebe vechattaot harebe, chayyav al kol achat veachat, shabbat, sheyyesh bah totzaot harebe vechattaot harebe, eno din sheyyehe chayyav al kol achat veechat. amarti lo, lo, im amarta vannidda, sheyyesh bah shete azharot, shehu muzhar al hannidda vehannidda muzheret alav, tomar bashshabbat, sheen bah ella azhara echat. amar li, habba al hakketannot yochiach, sheen bahen ella azhara achat vechayyav al kol achat veechat. amarti lo, lo, im amarta babba al hakketannot, sheaf al pi sheen bahen achshav, yesh bahen leachar zeman, tomar bashshabbat, sheen bah lo achshav velo leachar zeman. amar li, habba al habbehema yochiach. amarti lo, behema chashshabbat:

4.1: Safek achal chelev, safek lo achal. vaafillu achal, safek yesh bo chashshiur, safek sheen bo. chelev veshumman lefanav, achal et achad mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal. ishto vaachoto immo vabbayit, shagag beachat mehen veen yadua beezo mehen shagag. shabbat veyom chol, veasa melacha veachat mehen veen yadua beezo mehen asa. mevi asham taluy:
4.2: Keshem sheim achal chelev vechelev behelem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat, kach al lo hoda shellahen eno mevi ella asham echad. im hayta yedia ventayim, keshem shehu mevi chattat al kol achat veachat, kach hu mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat. keshem sheim achal chelev vedam notar ufiggul behelem echad, chayyav al kol echad veechad, kach al lo hoda shellahen mevi asham taluy al kol echad veechad. chelev venotar lefanav, achal achad mehem veen yadua eze mehem achal. ishto nidda vaachoto immo vabbayit, shagag beachat mehen veen yadua beezo mehen shagag. shabbat veyom hakkippurim veasa melacha ben hashshemashot veen yadua beeze mehem asa. rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yose, lo nechleku al haose melacha ben hashshemashot, shehu fatur, sheani omer, miktzat melacha asa mehayyom, umiktzatah lemachar. veal ma nechleku, al haose betoch hayyom veen yadua im beshabbat asa veim beyom hakkippurim asa. o al haose veen yadua meen ezo melacha asa. rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yehuda, potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy:
4.3: Rabbi shimon shezuri verabbi shimon omrim, lo nechleku al davar shehu mishshum shem echad, shehu chayyav. veal ma nechleku. al davar shehu mishshum shene shemot, sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yehuda, afillu nitkavven lelakket teenim velikket anavim, anavim velikket teenim, shechorot velikket levanot, levanot velikket shechorot, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yehuda, tameah ani im yiftor bah rabbi yehoshua. im ken, lamma neemar (Vayikra 4), asher chata bah. perat lemitassek:

5.1: Dam shechita bivhema, bechayya uveofot, ben temeim uven tehorim, dam nechira, vedam ikkur, vedam hakkaza shehannefesh yotza vo, chayyavim alav. dam hattechol, dam hallev, dam betzim, dam dagim, dam chagavim, dam hattamtzit, en chayyavin alehen. rabbi yehuda mechayyev bedam hattamtzit:
5.2: Rabbi akiva mechayyev al sefek meilot asham taluy, vachachamim potrim. umode rabbi akiva, sheen mevi et meilato ad shettitvadda lo, veyavi immah asham vadday. amar rabbi tarfon, ma laze mevi shete ashamot. ella yavi meila vechumshah, veyavi asham bishne selaim, veyomar, im vadday maalti, zo meilati veze ashami. veim safek, hammaot nedava veasham taluy. shemmimmin shehu mevi al hoda, mevi al lo hoda:
5.3: Amar lo rabbi akiva, nirim devarecha bimila meutta. hare shebba al yado sefek meila bemea mane, lo yafe lo sheyyavi asham bishte selaim veal yavi sefek meila bemea mane. ha mode rabbi akiva lerabbi tarfon bimila muatet. haishsha shehevia chattat haof safek, im ad shello nimleka noda lah sheyyalda vadday, taasenna vadday. shemmimmin shehi mevia al lo hoda, mevia al hoda:
5.4: Chaticha shel chullin vachaticha shel kodesh, achal achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, patur. rabbi akiva mechayyev beasham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi asham vadday. achal echad et harishona, uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon omer, shenehem meviim asham echad. rabbi yose omer, en shenayim meviim asham echad:
5.5: Chaticha shel chullin vachaticha shel chelev, achal achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, mevi asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi chattat. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon omer, shenehem meviim chattat echat. rabbi yose omer, en shenayim meviim chattat echat:
5.6: Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel kodesh, achal et achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, mevi asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi chattat veasham vadday. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi asham taluy, veze mevi asham taluy. rabbi shimon omer, shenehem meviim chattat veasham. rabbi yose omer, en shenayim meviim chattat veasham:
5.7: Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel chelev kodesh, achal et achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, mevi chattat. rabbi akiva omer, mevi asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi shete chattaot veasham vadday. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi chattat veze mevi chattat. rabbi akiva omer, ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy. rabbi shimon omer, ze chattat veze chattat, ushenehem meviim asham echad. rabbi yose omer, en shenayim meviin asham echad:
5.8: Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel chelev notar, achal et achat mehen veen yadua et eze mehen achal, mevi chattat veasham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi shalosh chattaot. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi chattat veasham taluy veze mevi chattat veasham taluy. rabbi shimon omer, ze chattat veze chattat, ushenehem meviim chattat echat. rabbi yose omer, kol chattat shehi vaa al chet, en shenayim meviim otah:

6.1: Hammevi asham taluy venoda lo shello chata, im ad shello nishchat, yetze veyire vaeder, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer, yikrav, sheim eno va al chet ze, hare hu va al chet acher. im mishshennishchat noda lo, haddam yishshafech vehabbasar yetze levet hasserefa. nizrak haddam, habbasar yeachel. rabbi yose omer, afillu haddam bakkos, yizzarek, vehabbasar yeachel:
6.2: Asham vadday eno chen. im ad shello nishchat, yetze veyire vaeder. mishshennishchat, hare ze yikkaver. nizrak haddam, habbasar yetze levet hasserefa. shor hanniskal eno chen. im ad shello niskal, yetze veyire vaeder. mishshenniskal, muttar bahanaa. egla arufa enah ken. im ad shello neerfa, tetze vetire vaeder. mishshenneerfa, tikkaver bimkomah, sheal safek baa mittechillatah, kippera sefekah vehalcha lah:
6.3: Rabbi eliezer omer, mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom uvechol shaa sheyyirtze, vehi nikret asham chasidim. amru alav al bava ven buti, shehaya mitnaddev asham taluy bechol yom, chutz meachar yom hakkippurim yom echad. amar, hammaon hazze, illu hayu mannichim li, hayiti mevi, ella omrim li, hameten ad shettikkanes lesafek. vachachamim omrim, en meviim asham taluy ella al davar shezzedono charet veshiggato chattat:
6.4: Chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim, chayyavin lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim. chayyave ashamot teluyin, peturim. mi shebba al yado sefek avera beyom hakkippurim, afillu im chashecha, patur, shekkol hayyom mechapper:
6.5: Haishsha sheyyesh aleha chattat haof safek, sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim, chayyevet lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim, mippene shemmachsherattah leechol bazzevachim. chattat haof habbaa al safek, im mishshennimleka noda lah, hare zo tikkaver:
6.6: Hammafrish shete selaim leasham velakach bahen shene elim leasham, im haya achad mehen yafe shete selaim, yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. lakach bahen shene elim lechullin, echad yafe shete selaim veechad yafe asara zuz, hayyafe shete selaim yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni limilato. echad leasham veechad lechullin, im haya shel asham yafe shete selaim, yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni limilato, veyavi immah sela vechumshah:
6.7: Hammafrish chattato, umet, lo yevienna veno acharav. velo yevienna mechet al chet, afillu al chelev sheachal emesh lo yevienna al chelev sheachal hayyom, shenneemar (Vayikra 4), karbano al chattato, sheyyehe karbano leshem cheto:
6.8: Meviin mehekdesh kisba, seira. mehekdesh seira, kisba. mehekdesh kisba useira, torin uvene yona. mehekdesh torin uvene yona, asirit haefa. ketzad. hifrish lechisba o lisira, heeni, yavi of. heeni, yavi asirit haefa. hifrish laasirit haefa, heeshir, yavi of. heeshir, yavi chisba useira. hifrish kisba o seira venistaavu, im ratza yavi vidmehen of. hifrish of venistaev, lo yavi vedamav asirit haefa, sheen laof pidyon:
6.9: Rabbi shimon omer, kevasim kodmin laizzim bechol makom. yachol mippene shehen muvcharin mehen. talmud lomar (Vayikra 4), veim keves yavi karbano lechattat, melammed sheshshenehem shekulin. torin kodmin livne yona vechol makom. yachol mippene shehen muvcharim mehen. talmud lomar (sham 12), uven yona o tor lechattat, melammed sheshshenehen shekulin. haav kodem laem bechol makom. yachol shekkevod haav odef al kevod haem, talmud lomar (sham 19), ish immo veaviv tirau, melammed sheshshenehem shekulim. aval amru chachamim, haav kodem laem bechol makom, mippene shehu veimmo chayyavin bichvod aviv. vechen betalmud tora, im zacha habben lifne harav, kodem et haav bechol makom, mippene shehu veaviv chayyavin bichvod rabbo:
